images.prompt: Create a restrained, highly legible conceptual research illustration for a Chinese Office Agent presentation, landscape 1536 by 1024. Use strict Swiss-grid minimalism with generous white negative space, flat 2D geometry, uniform fine line weights, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no decorative objects. The subject is human and LLM Agent collaboration inside ONE existing office task, not automobile driving and not a new app. At the center place a prominent blue document/workspace symbol labeled exactly "同一办公任务" with small text "Task". At the left, connect a simple continuous-loop symbol labeled exactly "Agent Control Loop" and "连续执行" to the central task. At the right, connect three small worker symbols grouped under the exact labels "Adaptive Swarm" and "受限协作" to the same task. Below the central task, connect two overlapping document symbols labeled "成果与版本". Above the central task, put a minimal symbolic human silhouette labeled "人工决策". Connect that human to the central task with an amber dashed line labeled "共驾边界" to indicate a research integration concept, not proof of implementation. All connections must be readable and must not cross labels. The central task is the only filled blue major element, all surrounding parts use simple dark outlines, the loop and retained document details may use restrained green. Use white #FFFFFF for at least 70 percent of the field, primary #1557D2, text #182230, green #008A63, amber #B86A00. Use clean Chinese sans-serif typography. The diagram fills the image area with generous inner margins, no extra page title, no slide footer, no progress badges, no risk levels, no screenshots, no dashboards, no robots, no external email or payment symbol. Exact labels only, no other prose. Color codes and color names are rendering guidance only, never visible text.
